rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Смотрите! Шишка закрылась! А вчера была раскрытая, как ёжик!
rows.text: Look! The pine cone closed! Yesterday it was open, like a hedgehog!
rows.heard: Look, the pine cone closed. Yesterday it was open like a hedgehog.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Bless you!
rows.heard: Bless you.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Холодная шишка! Может, ей ночью было зябко? И она закуталась. Как я без шарфа.
rows.text: A cold pine cone! Maybe it was chilly at night? So it wrapped up. Like me without a scarf.
rows.heard: A cold pine cone, maybe it was chilly at night, so it wrapped up, like me without a scarf.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Look at the grass. It's wet.
rows.heard: Look at the grass, it's wet.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: It rained last night!
rows.heard: It rained last night.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вчера было сухо, и шишка раскрылась. Сегодня сыро, и она закрылась.
rows.text: Yesterday it was dry, and the cone opened. Today it's damp, and it closed.
rows.heard: Yesterday it was dry and the cone opened. Today it's damp and it closed.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, шишка знает погоду? Шишка, будет завтра дождь? Кивни!
rows.text: So the cone knows the weather? Cone, will it rain tomorrow? Nod!
rows.heard: So the cone knows the weather. Cone will it rain tomorrow? Not.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: It's quiet. So shy.
rows.heard: It's quiet so shy.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Давайте проверим. Возьмём ещё шишки и сделаем опыт.
rows.text: Let's check. We'll get more cones and do an experiment.
rows.heard: Let's check, we'll get more cones and do an experiment.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот сосна. Шишки растут на ней.
rows.text: Look, here's a pine tree. Cones grow on it.
rows.heard: Look, here's a pine tree. Cones grow on it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Why does a pine need cones?
rows.heard: Why does a pine need cones?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: В шишке спрятаны семена. Из них вырастают новые сосны.
rows.text: Seeds hide inside the cone. New pine trees grow from them.
rows.heard: Seeds hide inside the cone. New pine trees grow from them.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Like an oak from an acorn!
rows.heard: like an oak from an acorn.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А вот раскрытая шишка. Под деревом лежала, где сухо.
rows.text: And here's an open cone. It was under the tree, where it's dry.
rows.heard: And here's an open cone. It was under the tree where it's dry.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: One is open, the other is closed!
rows.heard: One is open, the other is closed.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Возьмём обе домой. Посмотрим, что с ними будет.
rows.text: Let's take both home. We'll see what happens to them.
rows.heard: Let's take both home. We'll see what happens to them.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я понесу. Я теперь главный по шишкам.
rows.text: I'll carry them. I'm the Chief of Cones now.
rows.heard: I'll carry them, I'm the chief of cones now.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And this one. And this one!
rows.heard: And this one, and this one.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Главный по шишкам, ты их теряешь!
rows.text: Chief of Cones, you're dropping them!
rows.heard: Chief of cones, you're dropping them.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я не теряю. Я их сею. Пусть растут новые сосны.
rows.text: I'm not dropping them. I'm planting them. Let new pines grow.
rows.heard: I'm not dropping them, I'm planting them, let new pines grow.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Почти правда. Сосны так и сеют семена — только без помощи Рона.
rows.text: Almost true. That's how pines plant their seeds. Just without Ron's help.
rows.heard: Almost true, that's how pines plant their seeds, just without Ron's help.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Here's a bowl. With water.
rows.heard: Here's a bowl with water.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот раскрытая шишка. Она будет купаться?
rows.text: Here's the open cone. Is it going swimming?
rows.heard: Here's the open cone, is it going swimming?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Посмотрим, что она сделает в воде.
rows.text: Yes. Let's see what it does in the water.
rows.heard: Yes, let's see what it does in the water.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Шишка в воде. А теперь ждём.
rows.text: The cone is in. Now we wait.
rows.heard: The cone is in. Now we wait.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: How long?
rows.heard: How long?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: About an hour.
rows.heard: about an hour.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: An hour? That's forever!
rows.heard: An hour, that's forever.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Is it an hour yet?
rows.heard: Is it an hour yet?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: It's been one minute.
rows.heard: It's been one minute.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: What a long minute.
rows.heard: What a long minute!

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Meanwhile, let's draw what will happen.
rows.heard: Meanwhile, let's draw what will happen.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: I think it'll sink.
rows.heard: I think it'll sink.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А я думаю, она станет мокрой и закроется.
rows.text: And I think it'll get wet and close.
rows.heard: And I think it'll get wet and close.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я думаю, она научится плавать. Как лодка!
rows.text: And I think it'll learn to swim. Like a boat!
rows.heard: And I think it'll learn to swim, like a boat.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: In an hour, we'll know who's right.
rows.heard: In an hour, we'll know who's right.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: An hour later.
rows.heard: an hour later.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Look! The cone closed!
rows.heard: Look the cone closed

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: I was right!
rows.heard: I was right.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And it didn't sink. It floats.
rows.heard: And it didn't sink, it floats.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Почти как лодка. Я тоже немного угадал.
rows.text: Almost like a boat. I was a little right too.
rows.heard: Almost like a boat. I was a little right too.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Чешуйки шишки впитали воду и сомкнулись.
rows.text: The cone's scales soaked up water and closed.
rows.heard: Cone scales soaked up water and closed.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Шишка закрывается, когда сыро. Так она прячет семена от дождя.
rows.text: A cone closes when it's damp. That's how it hides its seeds from rain.
rows.heard: A cone closes when it's damp. That's how it hides its seeds from rain.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: And when it's dry?
rows.heard: and when it's dry.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Тогда раскрывается. Сухие семена разлетаются дальше.
rows.text: Then it opens. Dry seeds fly farther.
rows.heard: Then it opens, dry seeds fly farther.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, шишка не угадывает погоду. Она чувствует сырость!
rows.text: So the cone doesn't guess the weather. It feels the dampness!
rows.heard: So the cone doesn't guess the weather. It feels the dampness.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Точно. Влажный воздух — шишка закрыта. Сухой — раскрыта.
rows.text: Right. Damp air, the cone is closed. Dry air, it's open.
rows.heard: Right damp air the cone is closed. Dry air it's open.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А теперь положим мокрую шишку на окно. Там тепло и сухо.
rows.text: Now let's put the wet cone on the windowsill. It's warm and dry there.
rows.heard: Now let's put the wet cone on the windowsill. It's warm and dry there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: How long this time?
rows.heard: How long this time?

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Longer. Till tomorrow.
rows.heard: Longer till tomorrow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Till tomorrow? They're so slow.
rows.heard: Till tomorrow, they're so slow.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: But they're honest. They can't lie.
rows.heard: But they're honest. They can't lie.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: While we wait, let's look at a seed.
rows.heard: While we wait, let's look at a seed.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Семечко из шишки похоже на это пёрышко. У него есть крылышко.
rows.text: A cone seed looks like this little feather. It has a tiny wing.
rows.heard: A cone seed looks like this little feather. It has a tiny wing.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Оно падает и кружится, как маленький вертолётик.
rows.text: It falls and spins, like a tiny helicopter.
rows.heard: It falls and spins like a tiny helicopter.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Like this?
rows.heard: Like this.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Yes! But the seed is smaller.
rows.heard: Yes, but the seat is smaller.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: But I'm louder!
rows.heard: But I'm louder.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Повесим вторую шишку во дворе. Пусть живёт на улице.
rows.text: Let's hang the second cone in the yard. Let it live outside.
rows.heard: Let's hang the second cone in the yard. Let it live outside.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А я нарисую табличку. Сухо — раскрыта. Сыро — закрыта.
rows.text: And I'll draw a chart. Dry, open. Damp, closed.
rows.heard: And I'll draw a chart. Dry open, damp closed.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: It started to rain.
rows.heard: It started to rain.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Oh! Rain!
rows.heard: Oh, rain.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: The cone outside will get wet!
rows.heard: The cone outside will get wet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Пусть намокнет. Посмотрим, что она сделает.
rows.text: Let it get wet. We'll see what it does.
rows.heard: Let it get wet. We'll see what it does.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: Look! Its scales are already closing!
rows.heard: Look, its scales are already closing.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Шишка тоже прячется. Только у неё зонтик внутри!
rows.text: The cone is hiding too. But its umbrella is inside!
rows.heard: The cone is hiding too, but its umbrella is inside.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.text: The rain stopped.
rows.heard: The rain stopped.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Attention! Here's the weather forecast!
rows.heard: Attention, here's the weather forecast.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: С вами Рон и его помощница — шишка-синоптик.
rows.text: I'm Ron, with my helper, the weather cone.
rows.heard: I'm Ron, with my helper at the weather cone.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Шишка открыта. Значит, воздух сухой. Можно гулять!
rows.text: The cone is open. So the air is dry. Time to play outside!
rows.heard: The cone is open, so the air is dry. Time to play outside.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: What if it closes?
rows.heard: What if it closes?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда берём зонтик. И сидим под ним все вместе.
rows.text: Then we grab an umbrella. And all sit under it together.
rows.heard: Then we grab an umbrella and all sit under it together.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Good forecast. And easy to understand.
rows.heard: Good forecast and easy to understand.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Давай повесим шишку у двери. Будем смотреть на неё каждый день.
rows.text: Let's hang the cone by the door. We'll check it every day.
rows.heard: Let's hang the cone by the door. We'll check it every day.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Прогноз окончен. Всем спасибо. Шишка устала.
rows.text: The forecast is over. Thank you all. The cone is tired.
rows.heard: The forecast is over. Thank you all, the cone is tired.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Утром друзья проверили шишку на окне.
rows.text: In the morning, the friends checked the cone on the window.
rows.heard: In the morning, the friends check the cone on the window.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: It opened again!
rows.heard: It opened again.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Высохла — и раскрылась. Как мы и думали!
rows.text: It dried and opened. Just like we thought!
rows.heard: It dried and opened just like we thought.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Опыт получился. Она всегда следит за сыростью.
rows.text: The experiment worked. It always watches for damp air.
rows.heard: The experiment worked, it always watches for damp air.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Хочу такую же. Чтобы утром сразу знать, надевать ли сапоги.
rows.text: I want one too. So in the morning I know if I need boots.
rows.heard: I want one too, so in the morning I know if I need boots.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Можно взять две шишки. Одну тебе, одну на окно.
rows.text: We can take two cones. One for you, one for the window.
rows.heard: We can take two cones, one for you, one for the window.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: Two of them! What a weather station!
rows.heard: Two of them were a weather station.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я перечитал наш дневник. Смотрите, сколько мы узнали!
rows.text: I read our diary again. Look how much we've learned!
rows.heard: I read our diary again. Look how much we've learned.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Лужу на асфальте сушат солнце и ветер
rows.text: The sun and wind dry a puddle on the road.
rows.heard: The sun and wind dry a puddle on the road.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And I guarded it!
rows.heard: And I guarded it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: A compass always points north.
rows.heard: A compass always points north.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And I mixed it up!
rows.heard: And I mixed it up.

rows.name: Филя
rows.text: A pine cone closes when it's damp.
rows.heard: A pine cone closes when it's damp.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: And I do the weather forecast!
rows.heard: And I do the weather forecast.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: Ron, you're in everything.
rows.heard: Ron, you're in everything.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я же главный помощник. И сторож. И синоптик.
rows.text: I'm the main helper. And the guard. And the weatherman.
rows.heard: I'm the main helper, and the guard, and the weatherman.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: После дождей друзья снова пришли к камню, где посадили жёлудь.
rows.text: After the rains, the friends came back to the stone where they planted the acorn.
rows.heard: After the rains, the friends came back to the stone where they planted the acorn.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Земля влажная. Шишка бы сейчас закрылась.
rows.text: The ground is damp. A cone would close now.
rows.heard: The ground is damp. A cone would close now.

rows.name: Рон
rows.text: The acorn must like it.
rows.heard: The acorn must like it.

rows.name: Топа
rows.text: Look! Something green by the stone!
rows.heard: Look, something green by the stone.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: A sprout!
rows.heard: a sprout.

rows.name: Пик
rows.text: I think the acorn woke up!
rows.heard: I think the acorn woke up.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Запишу в дневник! Это самый важный день!
rows.text: I'll write it in the diary! It's the most important day!
rows.heard: I'll write it in the diary. It's the most important day.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll take a closer look. But carefully.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll take a closer look, but carefully.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тихо, все. Не разбудите его обратно.
rows.text: Shh, everyone. Don't wake it back to sleep.
rows.heard: SHH everyone, don't wake it back to sleep.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
